items.title: Solana sets Oct. 21 for Alpenglow upgrade targeting 150-millisecond finality
items.summary: The switch will replace Solana’s existing validator voting system, remove vote transactions from blocks and could sharply change headline transaction counts even if user activity stays flat.

items.title: Coinbase lays out flexible designs as key priority for Bitcoin’s post-quantum migration
items.summary: Coinbase published priorities for Bitcoin's post-quantum transition, urging early preparation for signature upgrades and fund migration.

items.title: Bitwise’s Hougan says Q3 charts point to ‘crypto spring’
items.summary: Bitwise’s Matt Hougan said nearly every fundamental indicator that Bitwise tracks spiked sharply higher.

items.title: Ledger Asks Resellers to Halt Sales in Seven Asian Markets
items.summary: The hardware-wallet maker says confirmed incidents remain confined to Southeast Asia, with no indication its systems or direct sales channel were compromised.
